description: Read-only: compares, and proposes or changes nothing (offer_swap is the tool that proposes a swap to a friend). Both directions of a trade with one player in ONE call: you_send (as match_wantlist) and you_get (as match_tradelist), each with its rows, card count and value in `currency` (default USD; CHF and EUR are what players at a table use), plus difference {amount, direction: you_send_more | you_get_more | even, unpriced_cards}. When unpriced_cards > 0 the gap leaves those cards out — say so, never call such a trade even. `with` is that player's handle ("@name") or one or two of their share links (their wantlist, their tradelist). A side they have not published is null and listed in not_published. This is everything that matches, NOT advice on which cards to trade and not an evened-out deal: present both lists and the gap, and let the players choose. Same disclosure duties as match_wantlist and match_tradelist: no proxy is ever offered; name every deck a copy breaks (copies[].breaks_decks, either side) and every copy in another language than asked. `with` names the player's handle also when reached by a wantlist or tradelist link.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

with.description: One handle ("@name"), or one or two share links of the same player

name: compare_trade

unpriced_cards.description: Cards on either side with no known price: the gap leaves them out. When > 0, say so and never call the trade even

difference.description: Everything that matches on both sides, not an evened-out deal; null unless both sides are published

with.description: The other player's handle ("@name"), also when reached by a wantlist or tradelist link; null for a deck share or a player without one

proxy_cards.description: Proxy copies on this side: name them

breaks_decks.description: Every deck a trade of this row's copies breaks: relay it before any trade talk
The decks of the copy's owner that claim it or play it shared: say "trading this card breaks <deck>" for each. Empty: no deck plays it
